lines.description: Specialized Carbon Fiber Nose Cone Kit - includes payload development kit, plus carbon fiber nose cone

Kit includes 3D printed ring, carbon fiber plate, quick release attachment, and DB9 connector. Comes assembled with fiberglass rods for integration of your own payload into the S2 modular payload system.
Tail boom assembly, with wiring harness
Composite left wing with hinges, control horns, D-sub connector, QR ball link, servo pockets, servos, servo covers, sensors, sensor covers, and pushrods.
Composite right wing with hinges, control horns, D-sub connector, QR ball link, servo pockets, servos, servo covers, sensors, sensor covers, and pushrods.  Includes laser altimeter and pitot.
Composite tail set with hinges, control horns, D-sub connector, QR ball link, servo pickets, servos, and pushrods.
S2 6S 14000 mAh 18650 battery pack with quick release case.
Pneumatic launcher for the S2 UAS, includes launch rail, pneumatic box and control system. Comes with shipping case.
SwiftStation ground station for use with SwiftTab and SwiftPilot autopilot.
Tablet and accessories, tablet setup and SwiftTab UI  Install

Includes S2 UAS airframe, avionics package consisting of SwiftCore™ Flight Management System (includes SwiftTab™ user interface installed on an Android®-based Control Tablet, Futaba 14SG Handset, and SwiftStation™
RTK enabled Ground Control Unit), toolkit, tripod, battery, charger, and hard shipping
